description: This file defines the 'VirtualBucketsRingProvider' class which is responsible for managing a consistent hashing ring with virtual buckets for distributed silo (node) management in Orleans runtime. It handles member addition/removal, range calculations, silo responsibilities, and event notifications.

classes.name: VirtualBucketsRingProvider
classes.description: A class implementing a consistent ring with virtual buckets for silo management, responsibilities, and range notifications within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Returns the current assigned ring range for this silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Allows external observers to subscribe to range change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Removes a subscribed observer from range change notifications.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles status updates for silos, including addition and removal, and initiates range updates accordingly.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Given a hash key, determines the primary silo responsible according to the ring.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from silo status events to clean up resources.
